aboutSection.title: TOMOSIA | 5.0 Solutions Company
aboutSection.description: TOMOSIA is a group of talented engineers with diverse information technology skills. Our mission is to leverage the individual knowledge and experience, as well as our teamwork and organizational learning, to derive optimal solutions to our clients' IT challenges.

serviceSection.heading: Service
serviceSection.description: At TOMOSIA, we can meet user needs with our extensive experience and track record in app and web system development, from development to system operation of recommendation systems, prediction systems, and customer-specific chatbots. In addition to development and operation, you can also rely on us for IT consulting services.
serviceSection.web_desc: We develop web systems using Ruby, Python, PHP and more. From frontend to backend, we support a wide range of needs, including server setup and deployment.
serviceSection.chatbot_desc: Based on ChatGPT technology, we integrate APIs such as LINE and Facebook Messenger to handle customer inquiries, questions, and bookings. We help you leverage chat for your business.
serviceSection.app_desc: Our IoT projects span smart home device integration, photo management, shopping apps, and live streaming services across many domains.
serviceSection.dx_desc: We provide full-cycle services covering every aspect of system development to support your DX initiatives, helping to improve operational efficiency.
serviceSection.ai_desc: We offer specialized AI, data analysis, and machine learning services. By integrating cutting-edge technology, we create optimized solutions to solve business challenges.
serviceSection.bigdata_desc: From web data collection and database creation to manual data labeling and categorization, we execute data creation processes efficiently to save time and cost.
serviceSection.mgpt_desc: Powered by ChatGPT technology and integrated with LINE and Facebook Messenger APIs, MGPT seamlessly handles customer inquiries, FAQs, and bookings. Let us help you elevate your business with advanced chat capabilities.

whySection.rapidly_desc: As of August 2023, we have approximately 120 employees and are rapidly expanding through aggressive recruitment. Our goal for this year is 150 employees. We can flexibly accommodate increases in staff and team size from 5 to 20 people.
whySection.japanese_desc: Our BrSE and project manager team will ensure accurate translation. Furthermore, they have a deep understanding of Japanese work culture, having worked or studied in Japan.
whySection.quality_desc: We have obtained ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications and are preparing for CMMI. Our organizational structure includes a testing team and a PMO team for cross-project management. We always perform checks before handing over products.

certificationSection.heading: Certifications
certificationSection.title: Certificate of Achievement
certificationSection.description: TOMOSIA is constantly striving to improve the company and plans to obtain globally recognized certifications. Furthermore, TOMOSIA actively participates in collaborations and plans to grow together with others.
certificationSection.jdxp_desc: JDXP stands for Japan Digital Transformation (DX) Partners, and it is an alliance organization comprised of companies in Vietnam that provide DX development and DX solutions.

achievementSection.heading: Achievements
achievementSection.bannerDesc: Here are some examples of our development work. We are contributing not only to cost reduction but also to solving labor shortages.
achievementSection.aiInterview_desc: Revolutionizing Recruitment - TOMOSIA's "AI Automated Interview Service" Dramatically Improves the Efficiency and Accuracy of Talent Selection
achievementSection.aiResponse_desc: The future of retail stores is revolutionized by AI-powered automated response systems: 24/7 reservation support for peace of mind even during busy hours.
achievementSection.gulliver_desc: Gulliver Auto offers a complete car appraisal and purchase process through its app. You can easily ask questions and get advice about the appraisal process via chat, and there are no telemarketing calls, making it a convenient app to use.
achievementSection.wakumo_desc: Wakumo is a daily job matching app where you can find work you can do right now! Work whenever and however much you want! No troublesome interviews or resumes required! Get paid immediately!
achievementSection.qlear_desc: We develop our own QR code generator and campaign website creation tool. This allows companies to implement a wide variety of campaign strategies easily and inexpensively, and the unique appearance of the QR code strongly attracts attention to the campaign itself.
achievementSection.coincome_desc: COINCOME Wallet is a decentralized wallet app (for iOS and Android) that allows you to easily manage, send, and receive Ethereum, Tether, and the proprietary currency "CIM" on your smartphone.
achievementSection.kiroku_desc: "kiroku" is an album recording app that connects you with people you want to share with. Whether you want to preserve your child's growth, or simply want to know how your parents who live far away are doing, "kiroku" creates a record of photos, videos, and comments!
